widgets_values: The image is a square vertical realistic photograph of an airplane window view, framed by the curved white edge of the fuselage. In the foreground, a large adult giraffe stands on the left side of the frame, its body partially obscured by thick, fluffy white clouds at the base, while its neck stretches upward against a clear pale blue sky. The giraffe has a pattern of irregular brown patches separated by cream-colored lines, with short ossicones on its head and alert dark eyes looking toward the viewer. Its fur appears soft and textured, catching the sunlight from above. A second, smaller giraffe stands further back in the distance, also rising from the cloud layer on the right-center of the frame, mirroring the first but appearing more distant and slightly less detailed due to atmospheric perspective. The clouds are voluminous and billowy, filling the lower half of the view outside the window, creating a surreal landscape that mimics a sea of clouds. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting midday sun high overhead, casting subtle shadows within the folds of the clouds and highlighting the giraffes' features without harsh contrasts. The composition centers the two animals within the oval aperture of the window, using the circular frame to create a vignette effect around the scene. The overall palette is dominated by natural tones: warm browns and creams on the giraffes, pure whites on the clouds, and soft azure blues in the sky above. No other objects or text appear in the frame, leaving the focus entirely on the surreal presence of these terrestrial creatures soaring above the clouds. The mood is dreamlike and whimsical, blending reality with fantasy through the impossible juxtaposition of wildlife and aviation. The image has a crisp clarity, sharp details on the animals and clouds, and a sense of calm stillness despite the unusual setting.

properties.asd_result: A young woman in a blue satin martial arts dress stands front-and-center. The dress is short-sleeved with puffed shoulders, featuring gold trim and a crescent moon design on the chest. She wears a wide white belt at her waist and has a high slit revealing one leg clad in a sheer dark stocking. She wears knee-high white lace-up combat boots. Her hair is dark brown, styled in two high buns adorned with white fabric and yellow accents, with bangs framing her face. She looks directly at the camera with red lipstick on. On her wrists are black spiked bracelets; her right arm is raised in a fist near her shoulder, while her left hand rests on her hip. Behind her, a wall covered in large graffiti tags painted in shades of blue, purple, yellow and white creates the background. The floor is grey concrete, flanked by rusted metal barrels to both sides. The lighting is bright and even.
